messages:
ada: seeing an uptick in gpu-attach failures in us-central2 since 18:07 UTC. provisioner shows 'attach_io_error' and local nvme checksum mismatches on a few hosts.
mike: any recent compactor or metadata-roll jobs?
ada: metadata-compactor job ran at 18:00 with agressive parallelism; compactor logs show 'corrupt_extent' on /dev/nvme0n1 for nodes gnode-uc2-11/14/29.
storage-bot: alert: nvme.checksum_errors increased x5 in cohort us-central2 at 18:05 UTC.
syl: checksum errors + compactor I/O could cause heavy re-writes and spur long write latencies -> attach blocked. can we pause compactor and mark affected hosts read-only?
mike: mitigation plan: 1) pause metadata-compactor for us-central2, 2) remount affected hosts with noatime and delay_commit=on where supported, 3) pin new GPU provisioning to us-east2 for 40m, 4) run offline fsck on affected nodes and collect SMART logs.
ada: executing pause flag: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"key":"metadata.compactor.parallelism","value":"1","scope":"us-central2"}'`
storage-bot: flag-change detected: "metadata.compactor.parallelism" 8 -> 1 by infra-deploy at 18:12 UTC.
mike: after throttling compactor and remounting two nodes, attach failures dropped 13% -> 2.6% within 8m. good signal.
syl: followups: 1) file STORAGE-599 with timeline, node list, iostat and smartctl outputs; 2) run a staging test that simulates compactor + attach traffic to detect checksum regressions early; 3) vendor to analyze drive-level checksum anomalies.
oncall-sre: acknowledged, opening INC-2026-220 and paging storage and release. please upload node fsck output and dmesg snippets to the incident doc. :rotating_light: :eyes:
